name: Jitsu Cloud Free Event Data Pipeline
free_limit: 200,000 active events/month, unlimited captured events and destinations, up to 1 daily active connector sync, with ClickHouse UI/API access on the $0 Jitsu Cloud Free plan.
watch_out: Active events are those delivered to destinations; exceeding the included allowance requires a paid upgrade according to official pricing. Do not confuse captured with active events; transformations and destinations affect usage. No credit card stated for Free signup; commercial-use terms and overage enforcement should be checked with provider. The separate MIT self-hosted offering requires your own infrastructure.
